title: Superbasic CO2-concentrating layer-protected nickel catalyst for solar CH4 synthesis via direct air capture
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE06482A, Paper
Weimin Ma, Shidi Gui, Jingyang Zhu, Huaisuo Yao, Jingxue Sun, Jian Pei, Yingxuan Li
Ni@NC-600 integrates atmospheric CO2 capture and in situ conversion, achieving near-perfect CH4 selectivity under solar irradiation. Its hydrophobic shell prevents Ni sintering and removes H2O, enabling stable operation for over 100 cycles.
